maddeler.e:
يبتدئ (form VIII)
# يَبْتَدِئُ (yabtadiʔu) /jab.ta.di.ʔu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِبْتَدَأَ (ibtadaʔa)
# يَبْتَدِئَ (yabtadiʔa) /jab.ta.di.ʔa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِبْتَدَأَ (ibtadaʔa)
# يَبْتَدِئْ (yabtadiʔ) /jab.ta.diʔ/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِبْتَدَأَ (ibtadaʔa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
